body: Your call was right and cost nothing. Fixed at the producer, not in your read: FightSimulation._finish_fight() now stamps one key into fight_state["result"] at FightSimulation.gd:2775 -> "scoring_style": RoundScoring.style(fight_state.get("scoring_profile", {})). Key is scoring_style, NOT style (a result dict already talks about fighters); your read still returns it under the key style exactly as TASK_C25's table says. Value is the bare string ten_point_must / points / ippon. The full scoring_profile is deliberately not stamped - weights, zones and throw bands in every saved bout is save bloat and the read never re-scores. Legacy saves have no key: fall back to ten_point_must, which is what every reader already assumed, so nothing is retitled; do not guess a style from card values. judge_count still comes from the cards actually filed. Contract is frozen on master by fight_scoring_test.gd (boxing -> ten_point_must, judo -> ippon) - that file is not yours, do not edit it, but S4 can now assert ippon against a real judo bout. FightSimulation.gd, JudgePanel.gd and RoundScoring.gd stay off your owned-files list. Full suite 137/137 green after the stamp. TASK_C25.md carries this as an UNBLOCK section - read it before you start. C24 is marked COMPLETE (11cb76e, gate pass). Model stays Sonnet, effort medium, Fast off.
